## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [法炬](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%82%AC) Fǎjù is a Mahāyāna sūtra concerning King *Yōu Tián* 優填 (Udayana), the legendary Indian king famous in Buddhist hagiography for commissioning the first Buddha-image. The work treats the *King Udayana*'s relations with the Buddha and his patronage of the *saṅgha*.

**Abstract**

[法炬](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%82%AC) Fǎjù (active late 3rd / early 4th c.) was a Western-Jìn translator. The translation belongs to the period c. 290 – 306 CE per the *Chū sānzàng jì jí*. The bracket adopted here reflects this window.

The Taishō text (T0332) is established on the standard apparatus.
